reader_summary.headline: Tom Lenehan is the Deputy Chief Investment Officer of The Rockefeller University.
reader_summary.overview: Tom Lenehan is the Deputy Chief Investment Officer of The Rockefeller University, where he helps lead the management of the University's $2B endowment. Rockefeller University is a unique duck – with a focused mission of improving the understanding of life for the benefit of humanity. Founded in 1901, it was the first institution in the country devoted exclusively to biomedical research.
